messages:
mira: FYI customer reported unexpected negative invoice preview after we ran recovery replay on shard-3 at 03:40. looks like two refund events landed for the same session.
jon: saw the alert on preview-negative-deltas. grabbing logs for t-509.
tara: tagged. do we have the replay-id? replay-service logs show job_id=rep-20250613-334.
metering-bot: Querying events: SELECT commit_seq, event_id, payload_hash, replay_id FROM metering_events WHERE tenant='t-509' ORDER BY commit_seq; returning rows (link).
jon: commit_seq 22 appears twice with different event_id and same tokens=-150. both show replay_id rep-20250613-334 in the second row and NULL in the first.
mira: so original refund emitted earlier, but the replay re-emitted a second refund without an idempotency key. that double-applied.
tara: current dedupe logic relies on unique(commit_key) at producer side which we don't enforce at aggregator. aggregator upserts by (tenant, session, commit_seq). replay preserved commit_seq, so conflict became additive.
jon: options: a) make aggregator detect duplicate payloads by storing payload_hash on ledger rows and suppress add if hash matches, b) change replay to mark replayed events with "replay_marker" and let aggregator ignore replayed duplicates when original exists, c) normalize commit_seq on replay to avoid collision.
mira: c) is risky for audits. b) requires replay infra changes and relies on replay always marking events; we can't trust older replays. a) seems the least invasive and helpful long-term.
tara: does ledger have room for payload_hash? we can add ledger.payload_hash varchar(64) NULL. backfill from metering_events for last 30 days.
jon: perf wise the upsert change is minimal: compute sha256(payload) earlier in pipeline; aggregator includes hash in insert. On conflict, if ledger.payload_hash = EXCLUDED.payload_hash then DO NOTHING.
mira: what about legitimate corrections that intentionally emit new payload at same commit_seq (correction flag)? we should preserve those edits. Add logic: if EXCLUDED.correction = true then allow replace/adjust ledger instead of suppress.
tara: correction field currently exists in metering_events but not propagated to aggregator. small fix to carry correction boolean.
jon: rollout plan: 1) DB migration to add ledger.payload_hash (nullable) and ledger.correction BOOLEAN DEFAULT false. 2) aggregator change behind ff: compute payload_hash and pass correction flag. 3) Backfill payload_hash for recent events. 4) Canary for 10% tenants. 5) Flip.
mira: monitoring: create grafana panel for 'ledger-suppressions' and 'preview-negative-deltas'. add alert if suppressed_count>0 and negative-delta decreases by <50% after canary.
tara: emergency mitigation: we can pause auto-replays for rep-20250613-* prefix in replay-service until patch lands. ops-oncall can flip.
ops-oncall: I can toggle that flag. will hold for shard-3 for now.
jon: tests: unit test upsert behavior: case A duplicate same hash -> no double-add; case B same commit_seq but correction=true -> apply overwrite semantics; case C different payload_hash -> add separate ledger row? we still key by commit_seq so conflict will occur; for C we should treat as two different events: maybe use (commit_seq, event_id) as unique key?
mira: we intentionally keep unique key as (tenant, session, commit_seq) for session semantics. different payload_hash with same commit_seq should probably be treated as correction if correction flag absent? hmm.
tara: agreed ambiguous. Let's enforce producer contract: corrections must set correction=true. Without correction flag, different payload at same commit_seq will be considered duplicate and suppressed if hash matches; if hash differs and no correction flag, raise anomaly and route to quarantine. Better to fail open into quarantine than silently double-charge.
jon: implement quarantine path: on conflict where hashes differ and correction=false -> write both events to quarantine table and emit alert. low volume but safe.
mira: sounds good. add metric 'ledger.quarantine_events' and alert threshold 1/min for prod.
ops-oncall: acknowledged, will mute replay flag and watch quarantine.
tara: I'll draft the migration and aggregator patch. jon, can you own tests and the suppression metric?
jon: on it. aiming to ship canary tomorrow morning.
mira: I'll update support ticket and add console banner for customers impacted (preview stale) until resolved.
tara: also include small audit tool: query to list suspect tenants: SELECT tenant, COUNT(*) FROM ledger WHERE window='preview' AND delta_tokens<0 GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY SUM(delta_tokens) ASC LIMIT 50;
jon: added note: include incoming_replay_id as trace field on metering_events so we can map replays to duplicates. nice to have.
mira: great. creating TRACKER-3310. thanks everyone. :party_popper:
